purpose: Sentinel-1 metadata and footprint-based scene-pair screening
aoi_status: Provisional rectangular search envelope; not a validated study-area polygon.

coverage_method.individual_coverage: Scene footprint intersection area divided by total AOI area.
coverage_method.shared_coverage: Area covered by both footprints inside the AOI divided by total AOI area.

screening_thresholds.note: These are configurable screening choices, not universal scientific standards. Validate them for the final AOI and analysis objective.

ranking_method.note: Heuristic ranking score from 0 to 100; not a probability, model confidence, flood detection, or damage estimate.

pagination_note: The catalogue client follows STAC next-page links when provided by the server and combines results across pages. Live searches returned 8 pre-event and 8 post-event items for the configured windows. These counts alone do not prove that multiple pages were available or retrieved.
interpretation_note: Candidate status means metadata checks and configured footprint coverage thresholds passed. It does not establish valid pixel coverage, co-registration, radiometric comparability, flood extent, or damage. Different pair combinations are not necessarily independent observations.
